attempts.summary: Configured firewalld on node1 (RHEL 9) as a persistent host firewall: public zone now permanently allows only SSH (service) and TCP 8080 (port), with cockpit and dhcpv6-client services removed so unrelated inbound traffic is rejected (icmpx admin-prohibited) by the zone's default target. Verified functionally before and after a full node reboot (boot_id changed bf4e9cbb...→a6aa9681...), confirming persistence, SSH/firewalld service health, and that port 8080 is reachable while an unrelated port (9090) is rejected.
